nodes.title: Solvent Soft Organic Hero
nodes.description: A totally new hero direction for Solvent inspired by Jeton.com, featuring oversized 110px Satoshi/Cabinet typography, soft peach/coral layered gradients, and organic hand-drawn decorative elements. Includes a scroll-activated glass pill header.

nodes.title: Solvent | Soft Jeton-Inspired Hero
nodes.description: A radical departure from neo-brutalism towards a premium, soft, organic aesthetic. Features peachy-pink mesh gradients, oversized Zodiak serif typography, and delicate pill-shaped UI components with deep soft shadows. Inspired by the clean, approachable luxury of Jeton.com.

nodes.title: Solvent | Warm Energy Hero
nodes.description: A totally new direction for the Solvent hero, inspired by Jeton's warm, organic, and friendly aesthetic. Features a coral-to-yellow gradient, soft blurred shapes, rounded friendly serif typography, and a inviting pastel color palette with abundant whitespace.

nodes.title: Solvent Onboarding | Ready to Begin
nodes.description: The final completion screen for Solvent's onboarding flow, featuring a Neo-Brutalist three-column quick-start guide, a detailed feature highlight panel, and a massive primary CTA. Designed for desktop with high-contrast charcoal and yellow tones.

nodes.title: Solvent Onboarding Step 3
nodes.description: Neo-Brutalist onboarding screen explaining the Solvent liquidity protection flow with animated progress bars, formula cards, and a multi-step process diagram.

nodes.title: Solvent Onboarding | Educational Screen
nodes.description: Educational onboarding screen for Solvent using Neo-Brutalist design tokens. Features a high-contrast charcoal and yellow palette, hard-shadowed feature cards, and a comparison table highlighting protocol benefits.

nodes.title: Solvent Onboarding Welcome
nodes.description: The introductory welcome screen for the Solvent treasury application, featuring a bold Neo-Brutalist design with high contrast, hard shadows, and a functional dashboard preview mockup.

nodes.title: Solvent Liquidity Management
nodes.description: A high-contrast Neo-Brutalist dashboard for managing treasury liquidity, featuring a 4-segment allocation bar, upcoming obligations table, reserve requirement progress, and risk forecasting. Designed for desktop with heavy charcoal backgrounds and vibrant yellow accents.

nodes.title: Solvent Transaction Modal System
nodes.description: A high-fidelity interactive demo showcasing the transaction modal ecosystem for Solvent. Demonstrates TransactionModal for inputs, ConfirmationPanel for reviews, and TransactionFeedback for async states using Neo-Brutalist design tokens.

nodes.title: Solvent | Deploy Capital
nodes.description: A Neo-Brutalist deployment interface featuring a StrategyCard for capital allocation, safety guardrail metrics, and transaction lifecycle feedback. Uses a charcoal/yellow theme with hard shadows and Cabinet Grotesk typography.

nodes.title: Manage Obligations | Solvent
nodes.description: Solvent workspace page for managing treasury obligations using a Neo-Brutalist design system. Features a creation form with validation and a list of outstanding promises with action controls.

nodes.title: Solvent Dashboard Overview
nodes.description: Neo-Brutalist dashboard cockpit for onchain treasury management. Features high-contrast card components, liquidity timeline with allocation mapping, stat tiles with skeletons, and a comprehensive activity feed using #ffe17c yellow and #171e19 charcoal.

nodes.title: Solvent | Connect Wallet
nodes.description: Neo-Brutalist wallet connection page for Solvent treasury app featuring a two-column layout with wallet selection, network switching prompts, and a comprehensive verification checklist card.

nodes.title: Solvent Treasury Setup
nodes.description: Neo-Brutalist treasury configuration page with a two-column layout, interactive form for asset and reserve selection, and a live deployment checklist to track smart contract wiring states.

nodes.title: Solvent | Complete Neo-Brutalist Experience
nodes.description: Extended landing page with 4 new substantial sections: Why Solvent (Charcoal/Yellow), How It Works (Yellow Steps), Metrics & Testimonials (Charcoal), and a Brutalist FAQ section.
